text_block_list.text:
The day of the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies had finally arrived.
It was a grand stage marking Mejiro Dober's very first GⅠ, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: —Alright.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Are you saying it's weird for me to be calm?
...Well, I'm a little surprised myself, honestly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
Even I'm a little surprised.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...I want to show results today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...I want to show results today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I want results that will give me the confidence
to know that even I can compete on the Tiara route...!
choice_data_list: I made a vow with Mejiro Bright.
I made a vow with Mejiro Bright, you know.

text_block_list.text:
A spark of fighting spirit resides in her eyes.
Far from being nervous, it seems closer to a warrior's eager shiver.
With this, I can send them off without any worries...!
choice_data_list: Let's go get some perfect results!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I told you, I was already planning to!
Well, I'm heading out—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
Well, I'm off—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Now, I'll show you!
Every single drop of my ultra brilliance!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Now, I'll show you!
Every single drop of my ultra brilliance!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Amazing...! Even though this should be
Pearl-san's first big stage too...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(As expected of an Umamusume who always brags
about 'having her sights set on the world'...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(...I can't let myself be beat in spirit.
I have to stand as tall and proud as I can...!)

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Fufu, that's a good look, Dober. I can tell you're brimming with fighting spirit and resolve.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Pearl-san—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"On this magnificent day,
let us clash our potential against one another.
Showtime will begin shortly!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I have no intention of losing.
I'll face this... with everything I have!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The big showdown to crown the Junior Class Queen.
Gate-in for the Hanshin JF will begin shortly!
(WOOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Incredible... So this is the roar... the atmosphere of a GⅠ...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(My body is trembling with electricity...
The racetrack feels wider than usual.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(My feet feel... so strange, and hot.
It's as if heat is rising straight up from the turf—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...I'm fine. Totally fine.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm calm. I can do this. I've got this—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I can... run!!
